subject: Evaluation governance kickoff — benchmarks, prompt owners & close path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@bioclarity.com>; Tom Reed <tom.reed@bioclarity.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation governance kickoff — benchmarks, prompt owners & close path

Hi Sofia + Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short bench spec doc that outlines the three evaluation tracks we recommended: 1) Safety & hallucination checks, 2) Latency/throughput cost sweep, and 3) accuracy/recall on your annotated test set.

High-level ask for this kickoff thread: confirm stakeholders and owners so we can lock milestone dates (pilot completion, acceptance criteria, and procurement close). Proposed owners from our side are below — please confirm or update. Once we have owners we’ll schedule weekly 30-minute syncs.

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- Aditya Rao — MAP owner & deployment sequencing (me)
- Lauren Bishop — Bench design and eval run ownership
- Michael Grant — CS/rollout & data ingestion lead (troubleshooting infra)

Proposed owners (BioClarity) — please confirm who will own these:
- Evaluation lead (test set, acceptance criteria)
- Security/compliance contact (SOC 2 evidence, data retention)
- Procurement/Legal point (for SLAs and SOW)

Key milestone targets (proposed):
- MAP finalization: Oct 12, 2027
- Eval runs (iter 1): Oct 18–22, 2027
- Acceptance decision & procurement signoff: Oct 29, 2027

Attachments: BioClarity_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (MAP draft), bench_spec_v1.md (bench definitions + sample prompts).

Next steps: if you can confirm internal owners and an evergreen calendar invite cadenced weekly, we’ll attach the detailed eval schedule and assign prompt sets to owners by Oct 7.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@bioclarity.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@bioclarity.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Legal Intake <legal@bioclarity.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation governance kickoff — benchmarks, prompt owners & close path

Thanks Aditya — this looks great and aligns with how we want to move. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Evaluation lead: Sofia Alvarez (me) — will own annotated test set and acceptance criteria
- Security/compliance: Tom Reed — will own SOC 2 evidence and data retention discussion (he loops in legal as needed)
- Procurement/Legal: Legal Intake <legal@bioclarity.com> — please expect an intro from our finance team next week

Calendar: Oct 7 weekly cadence works for us starting Oct 7 at 11:00 AM PT. I’ll send the invite once Tom confirms his calendar.

A couple of clarifying questions:
1) Bench: in bench_spec_v1.md you list 500 sample prompts for the initial sweep — can you confirm whether those are synthetic or partially redacted customer queries? We want to make sure PII handling is clear.
2) Data flow: for accuracy checks we prefer a staging bucket under our account — is Redwood able to pull from a pre-signed URL or do you prefer we share via S3 cross-account?

We’ll review the MAP doc and send any redlines by Friday (Oct 8).

Thanks,
Sofia
VP Product — BioClarity
sofia.alvarez@bioclarity.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@bioclarity.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@bioclarity.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation governance kickoff — benchmarks, prompt owners & close path

Appreciate the quick confirmations Sofia — perfect. Answers inline below and next actions at the bottom.

On Oct 5, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@bioclarity.com> wrote:
> 1) Bench: in bench_spec_v1.md you list 500 sample prompts for the initial sweep — can you confirm whether those are synthetic or partially redacted customer queries? We want to make sure PII handling is clear.

Short answer: the initial 500 are synthetic + curated templates derived from anonymized examples we’ve seen in past deployments. We flagged a separate redaction checklist in bench_spec_v1.md. If BioClarity wants to run the same bench against a redacted copy of live queries, we can add that as an orthogonal run (requires formal data transfer method and a separate acceptance gate).

> 2) Data flow: for accuracy checks we prefer a staging bucket under our account — is Redwood able to pull from a pre-signed URL or do you prefer we share via S3 cross-account?

Either works. Preferred: pre-signed URL(s) for the first run (simpler). For longer-term evals we recommend cross-account role for repeatability and logging. Michael will coordinate the exact steps — cc’ed.

Assigned action owners (updated):
- MAP owner: Aditya Rao (Redwood) — overall schedule, kickoff ops
- Bench owner: Lauren Bishop (Redwood) — will own prompt set, bench config, and run scripts
- Infra/data ingestion: Michael Grant (Redwood) — will handle bucket access and perf instrumentation
- Eval lead: Sofia Alvarez (BioClarity) — will own annotated test set and acceptance scorecard
- Security/compliance: Tom Reed (BioClarity) — will validate SOC 2 evidence and PKI/KMS requirements
- Procurement/legal: Legal Intake (BioClarity) — legal intake and SOW review

Immediate next steps:
- Sofia: redlines to MAP by Fri, Oct 8 (you mentioned).
- Lauren: will post a first prompt-owner roster by Oct 7 and open a shared sheet mapping prompts -> owner -> pass/fail thresholds.
- Michael: will email S3 pre-signed workflow and a perf tracing stub by Oct 8.
- Aditya: will finalize the calendar and push the updated MAP v0.2 by Oct 12.

We’ve attached a simplified checklist in the MAP (tab 2) that identifies acceptance gates. If anything looks off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

—
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@bioclarity.com>

Thanks — all looks good. I’ll take point on SOC 2 evidence and will loop in legal only if we need to surface a formal control gap. For now I’ll validate the checklist and confirm the data transfer approach (pre-signed URL for the initial run).

Sofia — I’ll send the calendar invite for the weekly sync on Oct 7 11:00 AM PT (accept once you see it).

Tom
Head of Security & Compliance — BioClarity
